findings: The same role-equality profile lookup now uses the role ASC/document-ID ASC index and applies limit 100 before fetching selected profile fields, replacing TableScan and MajorSort.
Availability lookups for one or 30 synthetic IDs use direct Values/Fetch plans, with a bounded sort; they do not scan the availability collection.
The index supports the existing query shape without changing user permissions, profile page membership, business documents or Function runtime.
limitations: Planner evidence does not measure real request frequency, latency, billed units or monetary savings.
The index adds storage and write maintenance. No other index was deleted or modified by the create-only operation.
The existing 100-profile cap and dispatch polling remain follow-up work.
